```{r, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(readODS)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(DT)
library(rsconnect)
library(plotly)
library(patchwork)
library(bslib)
library(bsicons)
library(plotly)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
#Dataframe

tasa <- read_ods("~/Documentos/RStudio/Ertzaina/Datos/tasa.ods") %>%
  mutate(round(across(3:46, ~ .x), 2))

tasa_th <- tasa %>%
  slice(1:3, 24:26)

tasa_th_25 <- tasa_th %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2025)

tasa_th_24 <- tasa_th %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2024)

tasa_capitales <- tasa %>%
  slice(5, 6, 9, 28, 29, 32)

tasa_capitales_25 <- tasa_capitales %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2025)

tasa_capitales_24 <- tasa_capitales %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2024)

tasa_mun <- tasa %>%
  slice(5:23, 28:46)

tasa_mun_25 <- tasa_mun %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2025)

tasa_mun_24 <- tasa_mun %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2024)

#--------------------TOTAL-------------------------------

tasa_th_total <- tasa_th %>%
  select(1, 2, 46) %>%
  rename(Total = `TOTAL INFRACCIONES PENALES`)

tasa_th_total_25 <- tasa_th_total %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2025)

tasa_th_total_24 <- tasa_th_total %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2024)

tasa_capitales_total <- tasa_capitales %>%
  select(1, 2, 46) %>%
  rename(Total = `TOTAL INFRACCIONES PENALES`)

tasa_capitales_total_25 <- tasa_capitales_total %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2025)

tasa_capitales_total_24 <- tasa_capitales_total %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2024)

tasa_mun_total <- tasa_mun %>%
  select(1, 2, 46) %>%
  rename(Total = `TOTAL INFRACCIONES PENALES`)

tasa_mun_total_25 <- tasa_mun_total %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2025)

tasa_mun_total_24 <- tasa_mun_total %>%
  filter(Fecha == 2024)

# Variacion

variacion <- read_ods("~/Documentos/RStudio/Ertzaina/Datos/variacion.ods") %>%
  mutate(round(across(2:45, ~ .x), 2))

variacion_th <- variacion %>%
  slice(1:3)%>%
  rename(Total = `TOTAL INFRACCIONES PENALES`)

variacion_capitales <- variacion %>%
  slice(5, 6, 9) %>%
  rename(Total = `TOTAL INFRACCIONES PENALES`)

variacion_mun <- variacion %>%
  slice(5:23) %>%
  rename(Total = `TOTAL INFRACCIONES PENALES`)

variacion_th_total <- variacion_th %>%
  select(1, 45)

variacion_capitales_total <- variacion_capitales %>%
  select(1, 45)

variacion_mun_total <- variacion_mun %>%
  select(1, 45)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# Gráficos
# TH

graf_tasa_th_total_24 <- ggplot(data = tasa_th_total_24) +
  geom_col(mapping = aes(x = reorder(Lugar,
                                     - Total
                                     ),
                         y = Total,
                         fill = Lugar,
                         color = "black"
                         ),
           show.legend = FALSE
           ) +
  labs(x = "Lugar",
       y = "Criminalidad Total"
       #title = "Criminalidad Total\n2024"
       ) +
 # scale_fill_gradient(low = "yellow", high = "darkred") +
  geom_label(aes(x = Lugar,
                 y = Total,
                 label = Total
                 ),
             size = 5,
            vjust = 0.5
            ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"
                                  ),
        axis.text.x = element_text(#angle = 45,
                                 color = "black", 
                                 size = 15,
                                 vjust = 0.5,
                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                 face = "bold"
                                 ),

graf_tasa_capitales_total_24 <- ggplot(data = tasa_capitales_total_24, 
       mapping = aes(x = reorder(Lugar, -Total), y = Total, fill = Lugar)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Vitoria-Gasteiz" = "purple", 
    "Donostia / San Sebastián" = "orange", 
    "Bilbao" = "darkgreen"

  geom_label(aes(label = Total), 
             fill = "white",
             color = "black",

  labs(x = "Lugar", y = "Criminalidad Total") +

# Municipios
mun <- unique(c(tasa_mun_total_24$Lugar, tasa_mun_total_25$Lugar, variacion_mun_total ))

getPalette = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))
mun_col = getPalette(length(mun))

names(mun_col) <- mun

graf_tasa_mun_total_24 <-  ggplot(data = tasa_mun_total_24) +
  geom_col(mapping = aes(x = reorder(Lugar,
                                     Total
                                     ),
                         y = Total,
                         fill = Lugar
                         ),
           color = "black",
           show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mun_col) +
  labs(x = "Lugar",
       y = "Criminalidad Total",
       #title = "Criminalidad Total 2025 - Tasa"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_label(aes(x = Lugar,
                 y = Total,
                 label = Total
                 ),
             size = 5,
             vjust = 0.5,
             hjust = 1
             ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  color = "darkblue",
                                  size = 30,
                                  face = "bold"
  ),
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45,
    color = "black", 
    size = 10,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 1,
    #face = "bold"
    ),
  axis.title = element_blank()
  )
```
